summary: Hyde-Smith has defended Israel in both official and public settings. A 2021 Senate press release expressed her disappointment that pro-Israel anti-terrorism legislation was blocked; 2023 remarks expressed support for Israel; and in May 2024 she posted that 70% of Gazans viewed Hamas's October 7 attack as 'correct' while joining an effort to block Gazan refugee admission. In February 2025 she cosponsored the Antisemitism Awareness Act, directing the Education Department to use the IHRA definition for campus investigations.
